CHALLENGER.MISSING_CHALLENGER: You're not currently participating in an A to Z Challenge. Click the button below to start a new challenge!
CHALLENGER.MISSING_ACCOUNT: To participate in the A to Z Challenge, you must first link a Riot account.

MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.TITLE: Verify Riot ID
MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.DESCRIPTION: Before participating in a challenge, we need to find your official Riot Games profile and verify that you own the account.
MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.VERIFY_DESCRIPTION: To confirm that this Riot account belongs to you, temporarily change your summoner icon to the icon below. After changing it in the League of Legends client, click "Verify Account".
MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.RIOT_ID_INVALID_FORMAT: Riot ID must include the hashtag (example: AURA Galactus#BR1)
MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.PLAYER_NOT_FOUND: Player not found on Riot servers. Check if the Riot ID and tag were entered correctly.
MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.SERVER_CONNECTION_ERROR: Internal server error while connecting to Riot services.
MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.VERIFICATION_EXPIRED: The verification has expired. Click reset and try again.
MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.ICON_CHECK_ERROR: Unable to verify the current profile icon.
MODAL_LINK_ACCOUNT.ICON_MISMATCH: The current icon does not match the verification icon. If you already changed it, wait a few seconds and try again. Riot servers may take some time to return the updated information.

MODAL_CREATE_CHALLENGER.TITLE: Register A to Z Challenge
MODAL_CREATE_CHALLENGER.DESCRIPTION: Choose the queue and lane where the challenge will be played.
MODAL_CREATE_CHALLENGER.QUEUE_TOOLTIP: Choose whether the challenge will be played in ranked games (Solo/Duo) or casual games (Blind Pick).
MODAL_CREATE_CHALLENGER.LANE_TOOLTIP: Select the lane that will be considered for the challenge. Only games played in this lane will count towards your progress.
MODAL_CREATE_CHALLENGER.ACTIVE_CHALLENGE_EXISTS: You already have an active challenge on this or another lane!
MODAL_CREATE_CHALLENGER.POPULATE_PROGRESS_ERROR: Failed to create lane-specific champion progress.
MODAL_CREATE_CHALLENGER.SERVER_ERROR: Internal server error while processing champions by lane.

SYNC_ERROR.RIOT_API_KEY_MISSING: Riot API key is not configured.
SYNC_ERROR.MATCH_HISTORY_ERROR: Failed to fetch match history from Riot.
SYNC_ERROR.RIOT_CONNECTION_ERROR: Internal error connecting to Riot services.

CHALLENGE_PAGE.DELETE_CONFIRMATION: Are you sure you want to delete this challenge?
CHALLENGE_PAGE.DELETE_WARNING: This action is irreversible. All challenge progress, including completed champions, losses, ratings, comments, and recorded time, will be permanently removed.

MODAL_CHAMPION.FUN_NOTE_DESCRIPTION: How fun was it playing this champion on a scale from 1 to 5?
MODAL_CHAMPION.COMMENTARY_DESCRIPTION: Tell us more about what you thought of playing this champion.
MODAL_CHAMPION.COMMENTARY_PLACEHOLDER: Ex.: Very healthy clear, strong ganks, but the late game was disappointing...
MODAL_CHAMPION.DATABASE_ERROR: Unable to save data to the database.
